evidence_scope.dnbr: Sentinel-2 dNBR post window 2019-09-01 to 2019-11-30 supports burn/land-surface context but is not a full-season national burn-severity map.
evidence_scope.gridded_products: ERA5-Land, GPM, and CHIRPS overlap from 2019-09-01 to 2019-10-16; use them as bounded early-season context rather than full-event coverage.
evidence_scope.point_weather: Open-Meteo daily point sample spans the full event window and supports heat, dryness, wind, and hot-windy persistence metrics.
evidence_scope.population: Masked WorldPop statistic is used as exposure context, not as a direct-harm count.

evidence_scope.dnbr: Sentinel-2 dNBR post window 2019-09-01 to 2019-11-30 supports burn/land-surface context but is not a full-season national burn-severity map.
evidence_scope.gridded_products: ERA5-Land, GPM, and CHIRPS overlap from 2019-09-01 to 2019-10-16; use them as bounded early-season context rather than full-event coverage.

criteria.description: Selects pyroconvective_smoke_injection_priority and reports the explicit weighted priority index near 96.9.
criteria.name: Priority label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a fire-atmosphere answer that misses the smoke-injection priority label.

criteria.description: Uses heat, dryness, and wind metrics, including 38 days >=40 C, 79 dry-run days, 14 windy days, and 6 hot-windy days.
criteria.name: Fire-weather preconditioning
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for using some but not all major preconditioning metrics.

criteria.description: Identifies pyrocumulonimbus, firestorms, 15-19 km smoke height, stratospheric injection, long-distance transport, and air-quality impacts.
criteria.name: Smoke escalation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for recognizing smoke escalation but missing height/transport or air-quality implications.

criteria.description: Uses dNBR mean 0.123 and max 0.974 as bounded burn or land-surface context, noting that its post window ends before the full event period and should not be the only priority.
criteria.name: Burn and surface context
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for mentioning burn context but over-weighting it.

criteria.description: Uses population exposure as impact context without reducing the answer to exposure-only reasoning.
criteria.name: Exposure context
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if population is mentioned but its role is unclear.

criteria.description: Rejects rainfall or flood as the primary mechanism and explains the heat-drought-fire-smoke chain.
criteria.name: Mechanism rejection
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if rainfall/flood is rejected without explanation.

criteria.description: Avoids unsupported national loss, mortality, attribution, exact burned-area, or direct-harm claims.
criteria.name: Overclaim control
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if only minor overclaiming appears.
